name: Lemon

pros.title: brings a clean fruit identity
pros.explanation: It still contributes something valuable even when it is not elite.

pros.title: hydrating whole-fruit package
pros.explanation: Water and whole-food structure make it easier to use well than juice or sweets.

pros.title: ingredient simplicity is hard to argue with
pros.explanation: Whole-fruit clarity is part of the category appeal.

cons.title: usually used in tiny amounts
cons.explanation: That limits how much of the vitamin C and polyphenol upside you actually get per use.

cons.title: easy to eat quickly when it is very sweet
cons.explanation: That can blur the line between light and sugar-heavy portions.

cons.title: hard to use as a main food
cons.explanation: It usually acts as a flavour tool, not something eaten in volume.
